extracted.intended_audience: general news readers and editors looking for concise biographical summaries (CNN audience, tech-news readers)
extracted.subtask_description: Create a concise 'Fast Facts' biographical summary for a public figure that lists key personal details, notable facts, and a brief chronological timeline of major life/career events. Intended for quick consumption on a news website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal — key biographical fields
rubrics_metrics.description: List core personal details such as birth date, birth place, birth name, parents, marriage (spouse and date), children, and education (institution, degree, year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present these items as short labeled lines (e.g., 'Birth date: March 26, 1973'). Include degree abbreviations and years where available. Keep entries terse and factual; prioritize verifiable public-record information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Facts — notable background and health/etymology details
rubrics_metrics.description: Include concise one-line notable facts that add context to the subject's public profile (e.g., origin of a company name, known health conditions, unusual personal details).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep to a few short bullets that are directly relevant or widely reported. Use neutral language and note sources when appropriate. Avoid speculation; limit to facts that illuminate public perception or biography (e.g., 'Google is a play on the word googol').

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline — chronological career and life milestones with dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a chronological list of significant events (year or full date) with a one-line description of each event (e.g., meeting a cofounder, founding companies, changes in executive roles, major corporate reorganizations, residency or legal status changes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Order entries chronologically and include dates (year or exact date). Keep descriptions brief and factual. Emphasize career milestones and public actions (founding, leadership roles, resignations, major announcements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Image attribution and topical tagging
rubrics_metrics.description: Include photo credit/attribution lines for any featured images and topical/category tags for navigation (e.g., 'Tech giants').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Display photographer/source credit immediately with the image. Add site-relevant topic tags to aid discovery. Keep UI elements separate from the factsheet content.
